svg.aria-label: Mission 01: Counterseal. Every irreversible action gets a second seal. Your agent gets a scoped token instead of your real API key. Deletes, force pushes and refunds wait for your passkey, and every decision can land in a public log anyone can check. Status: live, Free public beta. Launched 10 OCT 2026. npx counterseal login. Opens counterseal.gautamkhosla.com.
